title: Depth statement
description: One sentence as kinetic typography: every word flies in from deep in the frame (CSS 3D) and comes into focus, the camera keeps pushing in slowly, a light sweeps across the gold words and a gold line draws under them. Two soft pools of light drift behind.

props.text: required, one sentence, up to about 16 words
props.gold: a word or a list of words from the text to light up in gold

example.text: The same motion becomes a slide you can still edit
